body: Step inside your imagination with Project Genie, now powered by Google DeepMind’s most realistic and interactive world model yet, Genie 4. Project Genie brings our most advanced world and multimodal models together with Gemini so you can turn ideas into explorable, shareable worlds right in your browser: • Shape worlds in real time with Genie 4: Trigger dynamic events using natural language—like shifting the weather, introducing new characters, or changing the action mid-session—complete with simulated physics, natural lighting, and native scene-matched audio and character dialogue. • Build with the Project Genie agent: Describe the story or simulation you want to create, and the new agent generates starting visuals and custom background music, while Gemini observes in-session to suggest or trigger live events. • Explore & remix the community gallery: Jump into curated and community-built worlds, remix their environments, rules, and audio, or experiment with upgraded Genie 3 capabilities in the model picker (including up to 3-minute sessions and 360-degree panorama grounding). The new Project Genie experience is rolling out to eligible Google AI Ultra subscribers (18+), and Google AI Pro members can join the waitlist. Try Project Genie & join the waitlist: https://labs.google/projectgenie Learn more about Genie 4: https://deepmind.google/genie Read the announcement: https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/models-and-research/google-deepmind/genie-4-now-available-project-genie/ ___ Subscribe to our channel https://www.youtube.com/@googledeepmind Find us on X https://twitter.com/GoogleDeepMind Follow us on Instagram https://instagram.com/googledeepmind Add us on Linkedin https://www.linkedin.com/company/deepmind/
ar_body:
يقدّم الفيديو Project Genie بعد تشغيله بنموذج Genie 4 من Google DeepMind، ويجمع نماذج العوالم والنماذج متعددة الوسائط مع Gemini.

• تشكيل العوالم لحظياً بأوامر نصية مثل تغيير الطقس أو إضافة شخصيات، مع فيزياء محاكاة وإضاءة طبيعية وصوت وحوار مطابقين للمشهد.
• وكيل Project Genie يولّد المشاهد الأولية وموسيقى خلفية مخصصة، ويقترح Gemini أحداثاً أثناء الجلسة.
• معرض المجتمع لإعادة مزج البيئات والقواعد والصوت، وخيارات Genie 3 المحدّثة بجلسات حتى 3 دقائق وبانوراما 360 درجة.
• الإتاحة لمشتركي Google AI Ultra (18 سنة فأكثر)، وقائمة انتظار لـ AI Pro.
